comment: cowdiff states for f_100dc090 (cow_net_clock_ms_accum). Two reads - the clock pointer and the accumulator at object+0x10 - and a fuzzed pointer faults at the second, both sides fault, and the one instruction that is the whole unit goes unexamined (measured on a getter of this shape: 3 of 4 blocks). Each state publishes the object and names the field; the sentinel at +0x0c is there because the neighbouring field must NOT be what comes back, and the third state publishes the object somewhere else so a conversion that reached for the static block instead of the global is caught. Bytes are RAW little-endian.

states.note: accumulator 1000, seconds 7: the answer is 1000, not 7
accumulator 0xffffffff: the whole dword, sign and all
the object published elsewhere: only the global says where the field is
